item.title: Morgan Wallen’s ‘I’m the Problem’ Back at No. 1 on Billboard 200 for 14th Week
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the Billboard Breakdown, your weekly update on the latest music trends. I'm your host, [Name]. This week, we're seeing a familiar face return to the top spot on the Billboard 200 chart. Morgan Wallen's 'I'm the Problem' is back at number one for a 14th nonconsecutive week. Let's dive into the numbers."
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Morgan Wallen's song]
Host: "According to Luminate, 'I'm the Problem' earned 80,000 equivalent album units in the United States, with a 7% increase from the previous week. This surge is likely due to the release of Wallen's new standalone track, 'Been by Now', which dropped on July 24. He also performed the song live for the first time on July 18 as part of his 'Still the Problem Tour'."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "Meanwhile, Charli XCX is making waves with her new studio album 'Music, Fashion, Film', debuting at number three with 78,000 equivalent album units earned. This marks her largest debut week by equivalent album units and her fourth top 10-charted set."
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Charli XCX's song]
Host: "Olivia Rodrigo's 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love' remains steady at number two, with just under 80,000 equivalent album units earned. We'll be keeping an eye on these charts to see how they shift in the coming weeks."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this week's Billboard Breakdown. For all the latest chart news, follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on social media. We'll catch you next time with more updates on the music world."
